description: Reflect turns your HR and workforce data into answers, right inside ChatGPT. Ask in plain language and Reflect queries your people analytics directly: headcount, turnover, recruitment, compensation and more, with no export or spreadsheet. It also surfaces the figures behind your legal and compliance reports (BDESE, Egapro index, EU pay transparency). It explores the data catalog you're allowed to see, runs structured analytics queries, and handles advanced SQL when needed. Read-only and secure by design: every request respects your existing Reflect permissions.

defaultPrompt: Give me my headcount by gender
